svg.title: FilmSwipe
svg.desc: Postcard for FilmSwipe (android app, Kotlin): Swipe through films with a friend until you both like the same one. Room codes with live matching via Cloud Functions. Quick Duel with random players and live chat. TMDB films, offline watchlist, Play Billing. Built with Kotlin, Firebase, Cloud Functions, Retrofit, Hilt, Room, Lottie.
